manual_component_review.review_process: AI-assisted and user-reviewed; model outputs previously seen

limitations: Revised methods were developed after inspecting earlier test errors; the reused test set is not an untouched final evaluation.
The original and verified test pipelines use different model sizes; their comparison cannot isolate verification alone.
The manual component sample is small and does not cover all mismatch categories.
Targeted diagnostic examples are not a representative benchmark.
Example-level bootstrap does not account for shared questions or sources, model-run variation, or method selection.
Failed predictions remain in evaluation denominators.
